name: FL Mobile DAW & Sampler Studio
description: FL Studio Mobile style digital audio workstation with multi-track recording, MIDI pattern sequencer, 3-band parametric EQ, real-time spectrum frequency analyzer visualizers per track via Web Audio AnalyserNode, convolution reverb FX plugin, FL Studio desktop tension automation clips (BPM, volume, pan, filter, reverb), and advanced waveform sampler.
